 LANGUAGE plpgsql

        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(NEW.heading, '')), 'B') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(NEW.content_text, '')), 'C');
    RETURN NEW;
END;

extension_functions.acl_policy: Extension-provided functions (pgcrypto, citext, pg_trgm) retain their default ACL as installed by CREATE EXTENSION. They are EXCLUDED from any PUBLIC revocation: REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC would strip PUBLIC EXECUTE from these functions and break their operator classes and casts. PUBLIC revocation is applied per application-function signature only (see application_functions[].public_revoke).

default_privileges_public_revoke.creator: clarityit_owner
default_privileges_public_revoke.note: Ensures future functions created by clarityit_owner do NOT inherit the default PUBLIC EXECUTE. Owner-scoped: does not affect extension functions (owned by the extension installer). Companion to the per-signature revokes on existing functions.

public_revoke_scope.tables: No PUBLIC revocation needed — PostgreSQL grants no default table privileges to PUBLIC.
public_revoke_scope.application_functions: Per-signature REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION <each of the 10 application functions> FROM PUBLIC — NOT 'ON ALL FUNCTIONS', which would include the 81 extension functions. See application_functions[].public_revoke for the enumerated signatures.
public_revoke_scope.extension_functions: EXCLUDED from PUBLIC revoke — managed by CREATE EXTENSION; revoking would break operator classes/casts.

target_memberships.sql: GRANT clarityit_app TO clarityit WITH INHERIT TRUE, ADMIN FALSE, SET FALSE
target_memberships.rationale: Application login inherits app privileges (INHERIT TRUE); no delegation (ADMIN FALSE); no need to SET ROLE the grant group (SET FALSE).

target_memberships.sql: GRANT clarityit_owner TO clarityit_migrator WITH INHERIT FALSE, ADMIN FALSE, SET TRUE
target_memberships.rationale: Migrator SET ROLEs to owner to run migrations (SET TRUE authorizes this in PG16, not ADMIN); no delegation of owner membership (ADMIN FALSE); no ambient owner privileges (INHERIT FALSE).

target_ownership.note: All objects owned by clarityit_owner. NOLOGIN prevents direct connection; SET ROLE by clarityit_migrator activates owner authority. Owner inherently controls owned objects (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER).

target_roles.name: clarityit_app
target_roles.purpose: Application runtime grant group; owns nothing

target_roles.name: clarityit_owner
target_roles.purpose: NOLOGIN object owner; owns all objects; inherently controls them; activated via SET ROLE

target_roles.name: clarityit_migrator
target_roles.purpose: LOGIN NOINHERIT; may SET ROLE clarityit_owner to run migrations

target_roles.name: clarityit_admin
target_roles.purpose: Controlled role-administration identity; no ambient application ACL
